input.summary: Spec: 기획서와 디자인문서의 목표를 달성할 수 있도록 코드를 완성시켜라....

taskQueue.name: Implement App Root Component with State Management
taskQueue.description: Create src/App.tsx as root component. Implement state management using useState for tasks array and filter state. Implement CRUD operations: addTask (generate UUID, create Task object), toggleTask (map and update completed status), deleteTask (filter out task). Implement useMemo for filteredTasks computation based on filter state. Create basic layout structure with Tailwind CSS styling
taskQueue.validationRationale: Core component, will validate after all child components created

taskQueue.name: Create TaskInput Component
taskQueue.description: Create src/components/TaskInput.tsx. Implement controlled input field with useState for text. Handle form submission with validation (non-empty check). Call onAddTask callback prop with text. Clear input after successful submission. Style with Tailwind CSS (input field, submit button, form layout)
taskQueue.validationRationale: Batch component creation, validate after all components

taskQueue.name: Create TaskItem Component
taskQueue.description: Create src/components/TaskItem.tsx. Display task text, completion checkbox, and delete button. Implement checkbox onChange to call onToggle with task.id. Implement delete button onClick to call onDelete with task.id. Apply visual distinction for completed tasks (strikethrough, opacity). Style with Tailwind CSS (flex layout, spacing, hover effects)
taskQueue.validationRationale: Batch component creation, validate after all components

taskQueue.name: Create TaskList Component
taskQueue.description: Create src/components/TaskList.tsx. Receive tasks array and action handlers as props. Map through tasks and render TaskItem for each. Handle empty state display (show message when no tasks match filter). Pass onToggleTask and onDeleteTask handlers to TaskItem components. Style with Tailwind CSS (list container, spacing, empty state styling)
taskQueue.validationRationale: Batch component creation, validate after all components

taskQueue.name: Create TaskFilter Component
taskQueue.description: Create src/components/TaskFilter.tsx. Display three filter buttons: All, Active, Completed. Highlight active filter based on currentFilter prop. Implement onClick handlers to call onFilterChange with appropriate FilterType. Style with Tailwind CSS (button group, active state styling, hover effects)
taskQueue.validationRationale: Batch component creation, validate after all components

taskQueue.name: Integrate All Components in App
taskQueue.description: Wire all components together in App.tsx. Pass appropriate props to TaskInput (onAddTask), TaskFilter (currentFilter, onFilterChange), and TaskList (filteredTasks, onToggleTask, onDeleteTask). Ensure proper component composition and data flow. Verify all callbacks are correctly connected. Apply final layout styling with Tailwind CSS (container, spacing, responsive design)
taskQueue.validationRationale: Critical integration point - full validation needed to ensure all components work together

taskQueue.name: Final Integration & Verification
taskQueue.description: Comprehensive verification of all specification requirements: (1) Task creation with non-empty validation, (2) Task completion toggle functionality, (3) Task deletion, (4) Filter switching (All/Active/Completed), (5) Empty state display, (6) Proper TypeScript types throughout, (7) Tailwind CSS styling applied, (8) Responsive layout, (9) State management with useState and useMemo, (10) UUID generation for task IDs. Verify no missing components or incomplete features. Ensure complete application matches design document architecture
taskQueue.validationRationale: Final comprehensive validation of entire application
